title: lotus dorycnium subsp. lagunae
intro: Lotus dorycnium subsp. lagunae, commonly known as the lotus crested kidney or Mediterranean lotus, is a plant species within the genus Dorycnium. It is a perennial legume native to the Mediterranean region. The health benefits of Lotus dorycnium subsp. lagunae include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing inflammation, protecting against cell damage, and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which exert anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
